answer: An answer must include the first 21 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the cedar derivation is checked against the tide nonce, the signal audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 200 aliases produces 200 mismatches and burns the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
